USER REQUEST
Can you recommend me some books written by Alice Morse Earle that belong to the genre of domestic economy?

gpt-4o-mini.title: Home Life in Colonial Days
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A detailed exploration of domestic life and practices in early America, providing insights into household management.

gpt-4o-mini.title: The Sabbath in Puritan New England
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: An examination of the domestic practices and societal norms surrounding the Sabbath in New England, offering a glimpse into family life.

gpt-4o-mini.title: Home life in colonial days
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: Alice Morse Earle's exploration of domestic life in colonial America offers a detailed look into the everyday experiences and practices of families during that era, highlighting the social and economic aspects of home life. This insightful work in the Economie domestique genre provides a rich historical context for understanding the foundations of American domesticity.

gemma2:9b.title: Home Life in Old New England
gemma2:9b.explanation: Explores daily life and customs in 18th-century New England homes.

gemma2:9b.title: The Stage-Coach: A Story of Travel, Manners, and Domestic Economy in the Days Before Railroads
gemma2:9b.explanation: Follows a journey through early America, highlighting domestic practices of the time.

gemma2:9b.title: Two Hundred Years Ago: or, Life in England in the Days of Queen Anne
gemma2:9b.explanation: Illustrates 18th-century English domestic life and customs.
